name: Person
definition: An individual human being or a group of humans (e.g., demographic, tribe, or fictional character).

name: Location
definition: A geographical entity, facility, or infrastructure such as a city, country, building, or road.

name: Organization
definition: A group of people, company, institution, or association with a collective goal, including sports teams and political parties.

name: Creative Work
definition: A distinct artistic or intellectual creation such as a film, book, song, game, or television series.

name: Product
definition: A manufactured item, vehicle, weapon, or software.

name: Event
definition: A specific occurrence, competition, or happening in time.

name: Chemical Substance
definition: A chemical compound, drug, or element.

name: Biological Molecule
definition: A complex molecule essential to life, such as a protein, enzyme, or nucleic acid.

name: Organism
definition: An individual living thing, such as an animal, plant, or fungus, or a taxonomic group of living things.

name: Award
definition: A prize, honor, or trophy given for achievement.

name: Language
definition: A system of communication used by a community.

name: Currency
definition: A standard of value in the form of money or a monetary symbol.

name: Legislation
definition: A law or set of laws passed by a legislative body.

name: Disease
definition: A disorder of structure or function in a human, animal, or plant.

name: Concept
definition: An abstract idea, metric, or general notion.
